title: Large DOM text where the hook crashes or times out
reason_not_testable: The runner cannot force a hook crash or timeout: its only environment overrides are SECRET_HOOK_HOME and SECRET_HOOK_ROOTS, and the page-text MCP tool needs a live Chrome session. The onFailure setting and timeout are UNVERIFIED for this environment. Non-hook control: confirm onFailure is set to block in the hook config and check manually that the withheld result appears on PostToolUse.
